listing.name: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: My Life as a Darklord (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Player-managed My Life as a Darklord setup using its own WiiWare WAD.
listing.original_game_title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: My Life as a Darklord

steps.title: Prepare the WiiWare originals
steps.instruction: Keep the Windows x64 runtime and its DLLs together in a writable folder. Put your own NTSC-U My Life as a Darklord base WAD (WF2E) there. Add the matching optional DLC WAD only if you have it.

steps.title: Let the upstream player import the WADs
steps.instruction: Run mylifedarklord.exe from the upstream folder. The first launch populates game and, with matching DLC, game/dlc. Keep both original WADs separately from the generated files.

steps.title: Preserve the upstream profile
steps.instruction: Keep nand, mylifedarklord.ini, the generated game folder and the creating runtime together.

steps.title: Keep any optional King save import separate
steps.instruction: The upstream instructions describe reading a copied King save at nand/title/00010001/57464345/data/ARCH.SAV. Close both games, preserve the original King profile, and follow the upstream copy instructions only if you want the optional import.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.
